reply_text:
I found one dated 2023 prediction. Kai-Fu Lee said that within the next two to three years some research institution would build the greatest foundation model. That comes from a Chinese write-up of his March 14, 2023 media talk in Beijing, which I opened on the aggregator Marsbit. The text is in his voice in the first person, but it was put together by the outlet Chuangyebang (创业邦) and isn't an official transcript, so I've labelled it coverage_only.

- **Undated AGI line:** In his TIME100 AI profile (September 7, 2023), Lee told TIME AGI is "within grasp" by some measures. There's no date attached, so it goes under undated. The TIME page also had a block of sponsored ad text mixed in; I ignored it.
- **Pages with nothing to record:**
  - The Baillie Gifford interview (April 2023) only repeats his 2018 forecast that AI could automate half of US jobs by 2040.
  - The IEEE Spectrum interview turned out to be from May 2022.
  - The Pandaily page and the Bloomberg video page opened without the article or talk text.
- **Leads I couldn't check:** Search snippets show two dated claims from his May 28, 2023 Zhongguancun Forum talk: "within 3–5 years" for AI 2.0 platforms, and "the next twenty years" for five industry changes. I ran out of page openings before I could open either one, so I haven't recorded them. They're the best next step.
